reviews.body:
@pcbeingused333 - thank you for the PR. The merge approach fits #7466, and the existing validation still applies to the merged result. The 112 tests in `test_catalog_service.py` pass.

## Findings

  | # | Severity | Where | Issue | Fix |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | 1 | medium | `mcpgateway/services/catalog_service.py:648` | An empty or null submitted value overrides a non-empty catalog default, and `_build_oauth_config_from_credentials` then drops it. With `authorization_url: ""`, `token_url: None` and `scopes: []`, the result loses all three catalog defaults. The web form sends optional URL fields as empty, so UI users lose those defaults. | Drop blank submitted values before the merge, for example `{k: v for k, v in creds.items() if v not in (None, "", [])}`. Add a unit test with blank overrides. |
  | 2 | medium | `mcpgateway/services/catalog_service.py:648` | The merge applies every catalog `oauth` field, not only `resource`. It now also applies `issuer`, `authorization_url`, `token_url` and `scopes` when the caller sends none. A configured `issuer` turns on issuer pinning in `oauth_router.py:328`. | Say in the PR body that all catalog fields now apply. Add a test that `issuer`, `authorization_url` and `token_url` come through. |

@pcbeingused333 - thank you for the update! Both findings are fixed.

LGTM 🚀

Thank you for the fix. The merge of catalog `oauth` defaults into the submitted credentials addresses the root cause of #7466. The change is backend only. It needs no Alembic migration. The blank-value filter and the new unit test work as described. Reviewed head: `a6153151f`.

Two items need a change before merge.

## Required

1. **functionally-impacting | `mcpgateway/services/catalog_service.py:651` | `supports_dcr` is ignored.**
   The merge always sets the catalog `issuer`. `/oauth/authorize` then takes the DCR path when the user has no `client_id` (`oauth_router.py:738`). In `mcp-catalog.yml`, 14 of 69 OAuth entries have `supports_dcr: false`, for example `github`, `box` and `power-bi`. Before this PR, these entries returned 400 `OAuth configuration missing client_id`. I expect a DCR attempt and a generic 500 now. I did not run this case.
   Fix: test one `supports_dcr: false` entry end to end. If it regresses, skip the catalog `issuer` when `supports_dcr` is false and the caller sends no `client_id`. Add a unit test for that entry.

2. **functionally-impacting | `mcpgateway/services/catalog_service.py:651` | An `issuer` override keeps the catalog `authorization_url` and `token_url`.**
   A caller who submits a different `issuer` still receives the catalog endpoints. The stored config then pairs one issuer with endpoints from another authorization server.
   Fix: when the submitted `issuer` differs from the catalog `issuer`, drop the catalog `authorization_url` and `token_url`. Add a unit test for this case.

## Optional (can be deferred)

- suggestion | `catalog_service.py:651` | Validate `server_data["oauth"]` with `CatalogOAuthMetadata` (`extra="forbid"`) before the merge. The registration path reads raw YAML, and only the list path validates it.
- suggestion | `catalog_service.py:650` | Move the blank-value filter into `_build_oauth_config_from_credentials` through an optional `defaults` argument. The builder already skips `None` and `""`.
- suggestion | `catalog_service.py:643-649` | Shorten the new comment block to one line about behavior.
- minor | `catalog_service.py:693-698` | Log whether `issuer` and `scopes` came from the catalog or from the caller.
- minor | `catalog_service.py:425` | The builder docstring still says "both catalog registration paths". The mixed API-key path is dropped. Fix this in a follow-up.
- suggestion | tests | Add cases for a catalog entry without an `oauth` block, a malformed `oauth` value, and the mixed "OAuth2.1 & API Key" entry with and without `api_key`.
- suggestion | docs | Add one line to `docs/docs/manage/catalog.md` that catalog defaults apply when the caller sends none.

comments.body:
Thanks for the review. Pushed a commit that drops blank submitted values (`None`, `""`, `[]`) before the merge, with a test case for blank overrides, and the test now also checks that `issuer`, `authorization_url` and `token_url` come through from the catalog. The PR body now states that all catalog `oauth` fields apply when the caller sends none.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
